title: The plastic overlap and the adhesion of the contact points of the cylinder, cone and convex contacts
author: Claude-JG
description: The adhesive elasto-plastic model of ObjectContactSphereSphere (Edinburgh model: loading with k_c, unloading and reloading with K2 from a plastic overlap, adhesion, a constant pull-off force) is wanted for the other primitive contacts as an option (design contactPrimitives.md 3.3: a data block of 4 per contact point). Decided: the parameters contactPlasticityRatio, adhesionCoefficient, adhesionExponent, constantPullOffForce of SphereSphere for ObjectContactCylinderCylinder, CylinderTriangle, ConeCone, ConeTriangle and ConvexConvex; with contactPlasticityRatio > 0 each contact point has a block of 4 data coordinates, the fourth the plastic overlap; the law shared in ContactPrimitiveForce.h. SphereTriangle and SphereCylinder, which have one point and their own data layout, follow separately if wanted.
releaseNotes: The adhesive elasto-plastic model of ObjectContactSphereSphere (contactPlasticityRatio, adhesionCoefficient, adhesionExponent, constantPullOffForce) is an option of the cylinder, cone and convex contacts; each contact point then has 4 data coordinates.
